title: Admission control under a fixed overload
method: Synthetic thirty-second interval with equal-cost jobs. Backlog growth without rejection is (1,000 minus 800) times thirty = 6,000 jobs. The chart shows rates, not a claim of measured capacity.
alt: Admission control under a fixed overload: Offered work 1000 jobs per second, Safe completion rate 800 jobs per second, Early rejection 200 jobs per second. Illustrative inputs.
